title: console rendering, from the HotCRM pass: column label precedence, star rating widget, reference rail (nameField, refresh), gantt year, approval drawer approver and headline, public form heading and editor hints
body:
Filing gate ①: seven small rendering defects measured at a public door (findings A-02, A-03, B-13, B-14, B-20, C-18, A-09, B-08). Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim. One card on purpose: each item is a few lines in one file, all are `domain:ui`, and none needs a decision. One PR, with a pin per item. ## Items (read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`) 1. **A view's explicit column `label` loses to the field label** (A-02). - `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` about `:3508`–`:3511` passes `col.label` as the fallback of a translated field-label lookup. - An authored column label must win over the field's label. 2. **`type: rating` with `widget: 'star_rating'` renders as a text box** (A-03). - `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` resolves `widget` first (about `:3131`), finds no `field:star_rating`, and falls to the default text input (about `:4480`). - That contradicts the spec's promise that an unregistered widget "degrades to the `type` renderer". - `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (about `:3769`) maps `rating` cells to a number. - Fall back to the `type` renderer, and give `rating` a rating cell. 3. **The reference rail ignores `nameField`** (B-13). `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-reference-rail.tsx` `pickDisplayName` (about `:226`–`:245`) uses a fixed ladder, and the fetch (about `:440`–`:460`) keeps only `.fields` of the target schema. 4. **`refreshAfter: true` does not refresh the reference rail** (B-14). - The same file latches its fetch on `parentId::entriesSig` (about `:304`, `:370`–`:377`) and does not subscribe to the data-invalidation bus. - `RecordDetailView.tsx` `notifyRecordChanged` (about `:557`, `:1116`) posts only there. 5. **Gantt dates show no year** (B-20). `packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx` formats `{ month, day }` at about `:3978`, `:4000`, `:4013`, `:4302`, `:4522` and `:4837`. Show the year at least when it is not the current one. 6. **Approval drawer** (C-18), in `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`: - **Approver label:** `formatIdentity` (about `:222`–`:228`) cuts a long id in the middle ("positi…ager"). A `position:

` approver should show the position's label. - **Headline:** `decisionAmountEntry` (about `:632`–`:656`) takes the first key matching `AMOUNT_KEY_RE`, even a zero "Child Account Revenue". Prefer the object's declared amount field, and never headline a zero from an unrelated key. - Not in this item: the raw option values. the fix for #11677 (`3409fe89e4`, after the 17.7.0 pin) draws them through `RecordFieldFace`. #12081 item 7 can close against it once checked. 7. **Public form heading and editor hints** (A-09, B-08): - `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` `loadPublicForm` (about `:1436`) falls back to the object's API name. Use the object's label. - `packages/fields/src/widgets/RichTextField.tsx` about `:417`–`:418` shows "Format: markdown" and "Rich text editor (basic)" to anonymous visitors. Hide editor hints on the public surface. **Not in this card:** a completed task's due date shown as "Overdue" (C-19) is #11815, on hold until objectui installs a spec release with `settledWhen`. `domain:ui` · p3.
